title: Tear-off
description: A roll of ticket stubs printed with recently played songs — twist the end one and the perforation unzips hole by hole, yank it and it snaps clean. Every stub you tear off plays that song's preview.
intent: One physical mechanic finished to the edge: a perforation that unzips bridge by bridge under your own twist and snaps under a yank, with a real song as the reward for every stub.
